key_concepts: Wind blows due to differences in air pressure.
Air is a mixture of gases in the atmosphere.
The weight of gases in the atmosphere creates air pressure.
Temperature differences create differences in air pressure.
When air particles are heated, they move quickly, spread out, and rise.
Low air pressure areas have fewer air particles than high air pressure areas.
Air moves from high air pressure areas to low air pressure areas.
The greater the difference in air pressure, the stronger the wind.
Tropical cyclones can cause strong winds, flooding, landslides, storm surge, and epidemics
The effects of tropical cyclones can harm humans and other species.
Actions must be taken to prepare for tropical cyclone effects.
